To handle these three requests, a sales representative should follow official policy and the guidance of the relevant subject-matter experts, while avoiding the informal, overly optimistic claims in the sales playbook.

**Immediate Deletion:** Do not promise immediate deletion. Instead, explain that the standard policy marks data for deletion immediately upon termination (removing active access), but physical deletion takes up to 90 days [NL-009#NL-009-S08], [NL-019#NL-019-S05]. For Enterprise clients, a custom SLA is possible—e.g., purging active records within 30 days and backup archives within 60 days—but this must be documented in a formal Data Processing Agreement, and verbal commitments must be avoided [NL-019#NL-019-S05]. Always consult Priya Raman (Security and Governance Lead) before agreeing to any custom deletion terms [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Prepare the prospect for the standard 90-day policy if they push back [NL-023#NL-023-S07].

**Teams Availability:** Do not guarantee specific launch dates. Consult Sofia Almeida (VP Product) or the official Product Roadmap, which places the Microsoft Teams integration in the planning and design phase for Q4 2026 [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Do not release insecure 'alpha' features or one-off custom builds for a single client, as this breaks the multi-tenant infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines [NL-027#NL-027-S04]. Do not tell prospects the integration is "almost ready" [NL-027#NL-027-S04]. Instead, offer the responsive mobile web interface as a workaround and pitch the company's citation reliability and strict data isolation as the differentiator [NL-027#NL-027-S04].

**Custom Pricing:** Refer exclusively to the 2026 pricing schedule (NL-003) and do not quote deprecated 2025 rates [NL-004#NL-004-S05]. Do not quote final Enterprise pricing on discovery calls [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Current active rates are: Starter $1,200/month, Growth $3,600/month, and Enterprise starting at $8,500/month with a minimum $15,000 onboarding fee [NL-004#NL-004-S05]. Any custom discounts on the Starter or Growth plans must be approved by Marcus Reed (VP Sales) and align with the current pricing sheet [NL-009#NL-009-S08].
